_comment: The forge-native repositories and the CI files each must have (#544). Each needs a .github/workflows/review.yml that uses cgwalters-review.yml at review_pin, which is the pin of this repository's own review.yml (test-forge-sync checks that), a .github/dependabot.yml with a daily github-actions update, and a root Justfile. A repository is exempt from one of these, named review, dependabot or justfile, only through an entry in its `exempt` object whose value is the reason. `just forge-sync` reports each repository's drift from this file.

exempt.review: defines the review jobs and runs them from its own base revision (policy.yml), not through cgwalters-review.yml
defines cgwalters-review.yml and calls its own copy locally
